transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I've just been feeling incredibly depressed, sad, and empty inside for the past two months. I find myself crying all the time, and I've completely lost interest in doing anything I used to enjoy. I just feel so low and drained.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—extremely happy, full of energy, or like you didn't need much sleep?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods where I felt extremely happy, unusually energetic, or needed very little sleep. It has really been the exact opposite for me.
During this time that you've been feeling low, have you heard or seen things that other people couldn't, or had beliefs that others found unusual?

Yes, actually, since I started feeling so depressed, I've experienced some strange things. I sometimes hear faint voices whispering when no one is around, and I get this strong feeling that people on the street are watching or talking about me. None of this ever happened before I fell into this deep depression.
Have you ever experienced these voices or the feeling of being watched during a period when your mood was completely normal and you weren't feeling depressed?

No, I've never experienced those things when my mood was normal. I only hear those voices and feel like I'm being watched when I am feeling deeply depressed and down. They have never happened during times when I was feeling okay.
